edits.content: When comparing quantifiers, write their order explicitly, especially whether a witness may be chosen separately for each target or must work for all targets. Preserve the order of nested limits and distinguish limit superior from limit inferior: a limsup of −∞ forces eventual divergence to −∞, whereas a liminf of −∞ may hold only along a subsequence. Do not assume a liminf growth-exponent bound implies a constant-factor counting bound at the endpoint exponent; verify that implication.

For a complete classification, keep probability modalities and eventual-event conditions separate. Almost-sure convergence to one of several limits does not mean each limit occurs almost surely; positive probability of a branch does not imply certainty or automatic absorption. Match the claimed outcomes and events to the option exactly.
